basic_profile.bio: I'm a budding music producer based in Manchester, UK, exploring the depths of music theory. I have a passion for electronic music and spend my free time experimenting with different sounds and compositions. I'm currently enrolled in an online degree program with the University of London. When I'm not making music, you can find me hiking in the nearby Peak District or exploring local music venues. I'm single and usually online during the evenings, GMT. I dislike overly complex theoretical discussions without practical applications.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I've been learning music production through online courses and self-study. My formal education includes an ongoing degree in computer science, which complements my interest in music technology and production tools.
